recognize_zh: 視野中數個中型淋巴球核呈分葉或扭曲狀（類似花瓣的 flower cell），與小而圓的正常淋巴球並存，配合 HTLV-1 即可指向成人 T 細胞白血病/淋巴瘤（ATLL）。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells with irregular, lobulated to convoluted nuclei (flower-cell-like)
Condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli; scant to moderate pale basophilic cytoplasm
Admixed small round mature-appearing lymphocytes and a segmented neutrophil
Several smudged/crushed lymphoid cells with clear cytoplasmic halos
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows increased lymphoid cells, including medium-sized forms with irregular lobulated or convoluted nuclei, condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant pale basophilic cytoplasm, admixed with small round lymphocytes. A segmented neutrophil and several partially disrupted lymphoid cells are present. Red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis. The polylobated nuclear morphology is suggestive of adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma; confirmation requires flow cytometry (CD4+, CD25+, CD7-) and HTLV-1 serology.

ddx.vs: Sézary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei rather than distinct petal-like lobes, and are HTLV-1 negative.
T-PLL cells have round nuclei with a visible nucleolus and basophilic blebbed cytoplasm.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm that hugs RBCs and lack clover-leaf nuclear lobation.
